'''October 2000 Missoula tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Splash Page, Missoula, Montana on 15 October 2000. It is known from Cody Custis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1381">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-missoula-mt-oct-15-y2kd1381/ missoula-mt-oct-15-y2k], DeckTech (Cody "blackgecko" Custis, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-missoula-mt-oct-15-y2kd1381/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 October 2000
* '''Site:''' The Splash Page, Missoula, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
